description: Appendix G Aggregated is a dataset listed in UK Power Networks open data portal, an open data portal of an electricity distribution network operator, published or maintained by UK Power Networks. Introduction This table summarises the status of export connections at each GSP, giving the key summarised information from the Appendix G at a glance. The Transmission Backlog is a subset of the Total Generation Pipeline Capacity, with the earliest connection date being derived from the last person in the queue. Coverage: Great Britain (network area of the operator or portal owner). The portal files it under Network Usage. The portal shows 2026-08-28 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC BY 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support network planning and operations studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ukpn-open-data-portal.
